from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -30m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "comed.prices" and r._field == "price_cents_per_kwh" and r.period_type == "5min") |> last()

import "date"
start = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
kwh = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: start) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and (r.channel == "em:1" or r.channel == "em:7")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> integral(unit: 1h) |> sum() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
price = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: start) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "comed.prices" and r._field == "price_cents_per_kwh" and r.period_type == "hourly_avg") |> mean()
join(tables: {kwh: kwh, price: price}, on: ["_start"], method: "inner") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value_kwh * r._value_price / 100.0, _time: now() }))

from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -2m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and r.channel != "em:1" and r.channel != "em:7") |> last() |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 1) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _time: now() })) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["name"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.description: Billing-grade EAGLE meter alongside the Refoss split-phase mains sum. Should track within a few percent.

from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "comed.prices" and r._field == "price_cents_per_kwh" and r.period_type == "5min") |> yield(name: "5-min")

import "date"
nowt = now()
comed = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "comed.prices") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "comed", age_min: float(v: int(v: nowt) - int(v: r._time)) / 60000000000.0 })) |> keep(columns: ["source", "age_min"])
eagle = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "eagle.meter") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "eagle", age_min: float(v: int(v: nowt) - int(v: r._time)) / 60000000000.0 })) |> keep(columns: ["source", "age_min"])
refoss = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "refoss", age_min: float(v: int(v: nowt) - int(v: r._time)) / 60000000000.0 })) |> keep(columns: ["source", "age_min"])
nws = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -2h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nws.forecast") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ source: "nws", age_min: float(v: int(v: nowt) - int(v: r._time)) / 60000000000.0 })) |> keep(columns: ["source", "age_min"])
union(tables: [comed, eagle, refoss, nws])

panels.title: Daily AC kWh (em:2 + em:8) — last 30 days
panels.description: Daily kWh consumed by the AC compressors. Trending up at constant outdoor temps may indicate refrigerant leak, dirty coils, or compressor degradation. Once TCC is wired in Phase 4, this can be normalized as kWh-per-cooling-degree-day for true efficiency tracking.

targets.query: from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and (r.channel == "em:2" or r.channel == "em:8")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 24.0 / 1000.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_time"]) |> sum() |> group() |> yield(name: "AC kWh/day")

panels.title: Daily Furnace Blower kWh (em:9) — last 30 days

targets.query: from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and r.channel == "em:9") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 24.0 / 1000.0 })) |> yield(name: "Furnace blower kWh/day")

ac = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and (r.channel == "em:2" or r.channel == "em:8")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> integral(unit: 1h) |> sum() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value }))
home = from(bucket: "energy") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "refoss.channel" and r._field == "power_w" and (r.channel == "em:1" or r.channel == "em:7")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> integral(unit: 1h) |> sum()
join(tables: {a: ac, h: home}, on: ["_start"], method: "inner") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r._value_a / r._value_h * 100.0, _time: now() }))
